name: smear-cursor-vscode
displayName: Smear Cursor for Visual Studio Code
description: sphamba's smear-cursor.nvim ported to Visual Studio Code: animate the cursor with a smear effect.

smearCursor.disabledLanguages.description: Language ids where the smear is disabled (nvim: `filetypes_disabled`).

enumDescriptions: Use `cursorStyle` when a Vim/Neovim extension is active, `off` otherwise.
Infer the mode from the cursor style: line = insert, underline = replace, block = normal.
smearCursor.modeDetection.description: How to determine the editing mode, which selects the `*InsertMode` parameters and the `smearInsertMode` / `smearReplaceMode` toggles.

enumDescriptions: Follow the editor cursor style (including changes made by Vim extensions).

smearCursor.cursorColor.markdownDescription: Smear color. Empty uses the theme's `editorCursor.foreground`. Accepts a CSS color (`#d3cdc3`, `rgb(...)`), a theme color id (`terminal.ansiRed`), or `none` to match the text color at the target position.

smearCursor.cursorColorInsertMode.markdownDescription: Smear color in insert mode. Empty falls back to `#smearCursor.cursorColor#`.

smearCursor.smearBetweenEditors.description: Smear when switching editors within the same editor group, starting from the same on-screen position (nvim: `smear_between_buffers`). Switching between groups always jumps.

smearCursor.smearBetweenNeighborLines.markdownDescription: Smear when moving within a line or to a neighbor line. Use `#smearCursor.minHorizontalDistanceSmear#` and `#smearCursor.minVerticalDistanceSmear#` for finer control.

smearCursor.minHorizontalDistanceSmear.description: Only smear when moving at least this many columns (or the vertical minimum).

smearCursor.minVerticalDistanceSmear.description: Only smear when moving at least this many lines (or the horizontal minimum).

smearCursor.smearDiagonally.description: Smear when moving neither horizontally nor vertically.

smearCursor.scrollBufferSpace.description: When a cursor move scrolls the editor, draw the smear in buffer space (starting from the old line, clamped to the viewport) instead of screen space.

smearCursor.neverDrawOverTarget.description: Never draw the smear over the target cell, so the character under the cursor stays visible.

smearCursor.timeInterval.description: Time between animation frames, in milliseconds.

smearCursor.delayEventToSmear.description: Time the cursor has to stay still before the animation starts, in milliseconds. Coalesces bursts of cursor events.

smearCursor.stiffness.description: How fast the smear's head moves towards the target. 0: no movement, 1: instantaneous.

smearCursor.trailingStiffness.description: How fast the smear's tail moves towards the target. 0: no movement, 1: instantaneous.

smearCursor.anticipation.description: Initial velocity factor in the direction opposite to the target.

smearCursor.damping.description: Velocity reduction over time. 0: no reduction (bouncy), 1: full reduction.

smearCursor.trailingExponent.description: Controls whether middle points are closer to the head or the tail. < 1: closer to the tail, > 1: closer to the head.

smearCursor.distanceStopAnimating.description: Stop animating when the smear's tail is within this distance (in characters) from the target.

smearCursor.distanceStopAnimatingVertica.markdownDescription: `#smearCursor.distanceStopAnimating#` for a vertical bar moving vertically. nvim defaults to 0.875 because terminals cannot draw thin bars; VS Code draws them exactly.

smearCursor.gradientExponent.description: Longitudinal opacity gradient from head to tail. 0: no gradient, 1: linear, > 1: faster fade.

smearCursor.volumeReductionExponent.description: How much a diagonal smear thins as it stretches. 0: no reduction, 1: full reduction.

smearCursor.minimumVolumeFactor.description: Lower bound on the thinning of a diagonal smear. 0: no limit, 1: no reduction.

smearCursor.particlesEnabled.markdownDescription: Emit particles behind the moving cursor. Pairs well with `#smearCursor.neverDrawOverTarget#`.

smearCursor.particleSpread.description: Spread of emission around the cursor. 0: none, 1: over the entire cursor.

smearCursor.particlesPerSecond.description: Particles emitted per second while moving.

smearCursor.particlesPerLength.description: Particles emitted per character width travelled.

smearCursor.particleLifetimeDistribution.description: Higher values make short-lived particles more common.

smearCursor.particleMaxInitialVelocity.description: Maximum random initial velocity, in character widths per second.

smearCursor.particleVelocityFromCursor.description: Fraction of the cursor velocity inherited by new particles.

smearCursor.particleRandomVelocity.description: Random velocity jitter, in character widths per second.

smearCursor.particleGravity.description: Gravity, in character widths per second squared. Negative values make particles rise.

smearCursor.minDistanceEmitParticles.description: Minimum distance travelled per frame to emit particles, in character widths.
